Posting Details

Position Details

Title
Assistant Professor positions, Kelley School of Business

Appointment Status
Tenure Track

Department
IU Bloomington Finance

Location
Bloomington

Position Summary

The Finance Department in the Kelley School of Business at Indiana
University Bloomington invites applicants with expertise in finance
for tenure-track positions at the rank of Assistant Professor
beginning in fall 2027.

Basic Qualifications

A doctoral degree (or all but dissertation status) in Finance,
Economics, Real Estate, or related area is required. Candidates
should be able to demonstrate research excellence.

Department Contact for Questions

Those desiring further information on these positions may contact
the Department Chair, Finance Department, at KSBFIN@iu.edu .

Additional Qualifications

Salary and Rank

Special Instructions

Please note that this application is for candidates who have
completed or plan to complete their degree during or after 2026.
Candidates who graduated in 2025 or earlier should submit their
application using the separate ad for senior hiring titled
“Advanced Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Professor in
Finance.”
Interested applicants should review position requirements and apply
at https://indiana.peopleadmin.com/postings/33953
.
Applications received by November 20, 2026, will be assured full
consideration, but applications will continue to be accepted until
the positions are filled.
